context.issue_title: ISS-0104 — build.zig test-integration-env step name implies scoped ENV-01..05 subset but runs the full integration suite

task.description: Step 1: diagnose ISS-0104. Examine build.zig test-integration-env step definition. Determine whether root cause is naming or structural. Recommend fix approach (rename vs scope).
acceptance_criteria: Root cause classified into failure category A-E
Fix approach chosen (a or b) with rationale
Impact on umbrella test coverage documented

result.summary: Category A (build-tooling defect). env_integration_tests artifact uses main_test.zig root, running the full ~700-test suite despite the step name and description claiming ENV-01..05 scope only. Fix approach: Option B (scope the step to a new env_test_root.zig). Full diagnosis below.

issues.description: Incidental finding: test-integration-svc (svc_integration_tests artifact, build.zig ~line 2478) has the identical defect — it also uses tests/integration/main_test.zig as root despite the step description claiming SVC-01..SVC-04 scope only. Filed as separate issue for its own run.
issues.action: File as new GitHub issue and add to global queue — do NOT fix in this run

diagnosis.failure_category: A — Logic/structural defect: build step is misconfigured; the step is correct in intent but wrong in implementation
diagnosis.root_cause: build.zig lines 2492-2504 define env_integration_tests with root_source_file = 'tests/integration/main_test.zig'. main_test.zig is the full integration suite aggregate (130+ imports, 700+ test blocks covering all stages 1-14 plus ISS/EXP/XC/OIDC/SIM). Consequently test-integration-env compiles and runs the entire suite, not the ENV-01..05 subset its name and description promise.

evidence.comparison_correct_scoped_step: test-integration-ext02 (ISS-0637/GH-619) uses tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig directly as root — correctly scoped to EXT-02 only
evidence.comparison_also_broken: test-integration-svc also uses main_test.zig root (incidental finding — separate issue)

fix_decision.chosen: Option B — scope env_integration_tests to a dedicated env_test_root.zig
fix_decision.rationale: Option A (rename to 'test-integration-env-fullsuite') would make the step a meaningless duplicate of test-integration. The original intent — as stated in the step description 'Run Stage 14 ENV-01..ENV-05 integration tests' — is clearly a fast scoped regression subset for Stage 14 work. The step has value only if scoped. Option B delivers that value.

implementation.new_file_content: Thin shim importing env01_test.zig, env02_test.zig, env03_test.zig, env05_test.zig, env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig and calling comptime { _ = each }. All named modules (bpm, build_options, env, pg) are provided via integration_imports — no change to build.zig imports needed.
implementation.build_zig_change_2: Add: test_integration_others_step.dependOn(&run_env_integration_tests.step) — per ISS-0150/GH-466 policy: any narrow step must also be attached to the others barrier so the tests are guaranteed to run under the umbrella. The ENV files are already imported by main_test.zig, so this causes a second run of those 5 files under the umbrella — same as how env01_tt is handled at line 2168-2174.
implementation.umbrella_coverage_impact: None. ENV-01..05 tests continue to run inside the umbrella via integration_tests -> main_test.zig. The scoped step becomes a genuine fast subset (5 files, ~20-40s) rather than a full-suite duplicate.
implementation.env04_note: No env04_test.zig exists in tests/integration/ — ENV-04 has no integration test file. The scoped root covers ENV-01, ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05 only. This matches the existing main_test.zig imports.

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (Step 2) to produce design artefact, then BACKEND-DEV (Step 3) to implement
